data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2021 (2020 GBP 12.0m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported net prior-year releases of GBP 5.7m (net of reinsurance), but on a gross basis the claims development triangle shows a net strengthening of approximately GBP 12.0m driven by adverse development primarily in the 2019 underwriting year and a small adverse movement in 2018. Management note that the overall net release was driven by favourable development in Property offset by adverse development on Legal Indemnities.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was not stated explicitly as a gross amount in narrative (the report states a net release of GBP 5.7m). A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (page 41) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2021 and 2020) and comparing the current diagonal to the prior diagonal for 2018 and 2019. The triangle is presented in GBP '000; the computed gross PYD is +GBP 12.037m (strengthening) which differs from the reported net release of -GBP 5.7m (net of reinsurance). No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were quantified in the notes. Confidence in opening reserves is high (explicit balance sheet). Confidence in prior-year development is moderate-high (calculated from triangle) and lower for LOB-level amounts which are not quantified.
